title: Chosen compact-support to proper direct-image comparison
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and a proper morphism p with a chosen compactification, define F_p to Rp_* by comparing with the compactification whose open map is the identity, and removing derived identity open extension using its adjunction normalization [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

source.place: Tags 0F7B (proper/quasi-finite interchange), 0F7F (change of base), 0F7I and 0F7J (composition); proper/open tower in parent steps 1–3. Graph normalization: etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L.

proof.text: Use the inverse model-to-chosen comparison for ofIsProper p, whisker the identity-open comparison with Rp_*, and apply the left unitor.

mathlib_searches.query: Derived proper direct image commutes with etale extension by zero in a Cartesian square, compatibly with graph comparison and composition of compactly supported direct images
mathlib_searches.results: Eight matches: SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp, Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp, TwoSquare.lanBaseChange and general composition/base-change facts. None identifies the specified graph and compact-support comparisons.

mathlib_searches.query: For a Cartesian square with proper vertical maps and etale horizontal maps, derived proper direct image interchanges with etale extension by zero as the mate of inverse sum base change
mathlib_searches.results: Eight scheme etale/base-change matches; no comparison theorem for derived proper image and sum extension.
Twelve abstract mate results including mateEquiv_counit. These supply categorical manipulations but no graph/compact-support normalization.

General etale morphism and base-change facts, with no stated graph composition comparison. Local searches of both project roots found graph refinement and base-change coherence but not open-first graph composition or the proper/etale interchange.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No existing statement for either remaining geometric comparison.

from.place: Tags 0F7B (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open), 0F7F (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-base-change), 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition), and item (3) in the final paragraph of Tag 0F7L; parent steps 3, 4 and 5. def graphChosenProperComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper p] [HasCompactification p] :
    rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p ≅
      rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p
